sourceObservations: combat.c lines 162-174 builds target type 12 from every living party slot followed by every living monster slot and resolves the spell once.
resolvespell.c rolls shared duration and damage before applying resistance, save, protection, and special handling independently in target order.
Special 49 replaces a failed-save target's zero base damage with lethal damage while a successful save returns before the death effect.

Castle's monster target-12 branch reaches resolution before setting power or charging spell points and does not clear Guard or movement; Shatter's zero cost and unscaled effect make the stale power and resource state unobservable.
runtimeContract: A monster may choose Shatter when the complete living target set has more opposed than friendly actors. The cast resolves party then monsters through the shared group save and special-49 death path, spends no spell points, and deliberately clears Guard and movement as one ordinary action.
